# annotation-cli

> Label model outputs in the terminal with single-key choices, undo, resumable append-only JSONL storage, safe display of untrusted text and Cohen's kappa agreement. Python package `trysac-annotation-cli`, import name `annotation_cli`, MIT licensed, Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.

- [Security](docs/SECURITY.md): threat model and limits
- [Project](docs/PROJECT.md): objective, scope and out-of-scope
- [Stack](docs/STACK.md): tools used and discarded
